features.feature: Cross-platform proper-lockfile mutex wraps the build critical section (build currently has no lock)
Mutex never age-steals a live long-running build (heartbeat: stale>=30000ms, update interval < stale/2)
Race-free reclaim of a dead/stale lock holder (fixes check-then-delete TOCTOU race)
Lock wraps the entire critical section: acquired before rm(dist), released after writeBuildBinding
Lock implementation uses proper-lockfile mkdir strategy only, no native module (flock/fcntl) dependency, cross-platform Mac/Linux/Windows
Lock is acquired at all three build call sites (ensure-dist.mjs, build-main-with-binding.mjs, packages/utils build)
Lock is released on build failure (tsc error) and on normal completion without leaking across sequential runs
Add proper-lockfile as a new dependency in root package.json
Build skip decision becomes content-bound via existing verifyBuildBinding (sha256 over src+config+dist) instead of mtime/existence
Deleted-source orphan detection: sourceDigest change triggers rebuild and removes stale .js output for the deleted file
Partial/interrupted build detection: distDigest change (missing dist file) triggers rebuild that restores the missing file
Tampered non-index dist file detection: any dist file content change triggers rebuild, not just index.js
sourceDigest is recomputed from actual source files on disk, never trusted from a copied/stale manifest
Existence-only reuse is eliminated: skip decision is not based on existsSync(dist/index.js)
Absent/missing binding manifest is treated as unverified and triggers a rebuild, not silently skipped
New packages/utils build-binding covering utils/src + tsconfig + package.json + the packages/main/dist it links against
Utils binding detects staleness when packages/main/dist changes (dependency-aware freshness across packages)
Content-bound skip applied in ensure-dist.mjs for BOTH packages/main and packages/utils
Content-bound skip applied in build-main-with-binding.mjs (the packages-main-build validate command)
Concurrent npm test invocations in one worktree never corrupt dist (no ENOTEMPTY/TS2307/MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
Any source change, including whitespace/comment-only edits, triggers a rebuild (fine-grained content sensitivity, not a coarse hash)
Repro-first RED tests (lock-liveness, content-binding, guard-bite) wired via validate.commands / REGISTRATION_EXCLUSIONS under packages/main/tests/red/
No atomic-publish / symlink dist-swap mechanism (YAGNI per approved design)
